g.text: DOC behaviour across physical river settings
Source-training observations only, partitions 142 / 143 / 144. Each station appears once after averaging its available partition summaries.
Profiles overlap. C–Q slopes require 24 paired DOC–flow months and adjust for annual sine/cosine; associations are observational.
